rooms.description: You are in an ancient barrow which opens to the southwest.
rooms.title: Inside the Barrow

rooms.description: Halls lead west and south. The Wizard's workbench dominates the room. It is stained from years of use, and is deeply gouged as though some huge clawed animal was imprisoned on it. In the center of the bench, three stands - ruby, sapphire, and diamond - form a triangle.
rooms.title: Wizard's Workshop

rooms.description: You are ankle deep in a stream. To the southwest is a dark tunnel, and to the north a dim cavern.
rooms.title: Shallow Ford

rooms.description: This is a former broom closet. A larger room lies to the north. Chiselled on the wall are the words "Protected by the Frobozz Magic Alarm Company."
rooms.title: Dingy Closet

rooms.description: You are on a north-south bridge spanning a deep ravine. Water flows far beneath.
rooms.title: Stone Bridge

rooms.description: The far half of this room is depressed. The only exit is west.
rooms.title: Pool Room

rooms.description: This is the southern end of a garden, where fantastically shaped hedges are arrayed with geometric precision. Though recently untended, the bushes have clearly been shaped: There is a dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures. To the west is a tunnel.
rooms.title: Topiary

rooms.description: This room is full of assorted machinery, whirring noisily. On one wall is a triangular button labelled, "DANGER -- HIGH VOLTAGE." There are exits to the south and southwest.
rooms.title: Machine Room

rooms.description: Inscribed on the floor is a great pentagram drawn with black chalk. In its center is a black circle.
rooms.title: Pentagram Room

rooms.description: Before you are the earthly remains of the mighty Flatheads, twelve somewhat flat heads mounted securely on poles. There is writing carved on the crypt. To the north and south are dark doorways.
rooms.title: Crypt

rooms.description: In the center of this enormous room, four wooden posts support a huge oblong roof. To the east is a large hole; to the west a gaping chasm.
rooms.title: Posts Room

rooms.description: This was once a kennel for a large dog (some of the bones would fit a dinosaur). The only exit is northeast.
rooms.title: Kennel

rooms.description: This is a tall, damp room with brick walls. There are some etchings on the walls. A passage leads west.
rooms.title: Circular Room

rooms.description: This must have been a large library, probably for the royal family. All of the shelves have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes. To the north is an exit.
rooms.title: Library

rooms.description: A path of crushed white stone winds among bushes and flower beds of this garden from south to north. Almost hidden by the shrubbery is a small white gazebo.
rooms.title: Formal Garden

rooms.description: This smooth-walled tunnel runs northeast to southwest. A faint whirring sound comes from the latter direction. Another opening, choked with leaves, leads southeast.
rooms.title: Dark Tunnel

rooms.description: This is the entrance to a huge tomb. A passage leads north.
rooms.title: Cerberus Room

rooms.description: The air is cool and damp. A path from the southeast splits here; north toward a stone bridge, and west into a narrow tunnel. It is from the latter that the chill originates.
rooms.title: Cool Room

rooms.description: You are at the base of a dormant volcano. High above, light enters the cone of the volcano. The only exit is east.
rooms.title: Volcano Bottom

rooms.description: This is a huge limestone cavern, glowing with dim, phosphorescent light from far above. Narrow paths wind south and northeast.
rooms.title: Great Cavern

rooms.description: An oblong table here is set for afternoon tea. It is clear that the users were indeed mad. To the east is a small hole (perhaps four inches high). A doorway leads west.
rooms.title: Tea Room

rooms.description: The rock walls are scarred by flame, and a blackened doorway leads south.
rooms.title: Dragon's Lair

rooms.description: This is a small chamber carved from the western end of a short crawl. On the wall is crudely chiseled the number "8".
rooms.title: Room 8

rooms.description: You are waist deep in a cold stream. On the northern bank, the walls rise to a small ledge. A "whir" comes from an opening to the south.
rooms.title: Deep Ford

rooms.description: Here a dark hallway turns a corner. To the south is a dark room, to the east is fitful light.
rooms.title: Aquarium Room

rooms.description: This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.
rooms.title: Gazebo

rooms.description: You have made it to the top. Well done. There are etchings on the well. A crack runs across the floor at the doorway to the east, but it can be crossed easily. Another doorway leads northeast.
rooms.title: Top of Well

rooms.description: The walls of this large cavern are scorched and a sooty dry smell is very strong here. A stone bridge leads the south, and a smokey tunnel opens to the north. To the east is a small opening.
rooms.title: Dragon Room
